title: Pointwise generator cancellation for simultaneous f-divergence
source_anchor: Sinho Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling, Theorem 8.3.1 proof: after applying the two adjoint equations, the proof combines the product reconstruction from Definition 1.2.12 with the diffusion generator chain rule Eq. (2.2.15), then uses the carré-du-champ chain rule Eq. (2.2.14) to reduce rho L(f'∘rho) - L((f'∘rho)rho) + L(f∘rho) to -f''(rho) Gamma(rho).
target_statement: Formalize only the pointwise algebraic cancellation rho L(f'∘rho) - L((f'∘rho)rho) + L(f∘rho) = -f''(rho) Gamma(rho,rho), with the product reconstruction, generator scalar chain rule, and carré-du-champ scalar chain rule exposed as separate parent hypotheses. Do not assume adjoint evolution, differentiation under the integral, density regularity, or the final dissipation theorem.

shared_floor_audit.notes: This cell is deliberately an algebraic join rather than a new generator axiom. It can compile independently by taking the three source identities as hypotheses, while later source-facing assembly must discharge those hypotheses from the canonical product, Eq. (2.2.15), and Gamma-chain nodes. Keeping the join separate prevents the final dissipation formula from being smuggled in as an assumption and prevents adjoint/integrability assumptions from contaminating the reusable algebraic node.
